import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
#check_failure MvPolynomial.taylor_X
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_X
#print MvPolynomial.aeval_X
namespace TaylorXRaw
theorem universal {σ R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (f : σ → A) (j : σ) : MvPolynomial.aeval (R := R) f (MvPolynomial.X j) = f j :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
theorem inline {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (j : σ) :
    (let T : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
      MvPolynomial.aeval fun k ↦ MvPolynomial.X k + MvPolynomial.C (α k)
     T (MvPolynomial.X j)) = MvPolynomial.X j + MvPolynomial.C (α j) :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
#print axioms universal
#print axioms inline
end TaylorXRaw
